title: TemperatureSensor
description: A device that consists of a sensor, has category saref:Sensor, performs the saref:SensingFunction and is used for the purpose of sensing a property of type saref:Temperature. In the FIWARE NGSI-LD tutorial dataset this is an NGSI-LD **Device** entity whose controlledProperty includes 'temperature'. No instances exist on the current broker; this profile is derived from the user @context, SAREF and the Smart Data Models Device schema.

category.description: Device category. Fixed to 'sensor' for this profile.

temperature.description: Latest reading for temperature. Unit code CEL.
